## SMBsync+ 2.55-plus.14

- Targets current Android versions to remove the old-app compatibility warning.
- On Android 11 and newer, opens a file-access setup screen instead of closing before unlock when storage access is missing. The app resumes after you grant access.
- Fixes a scheduled-alarm startup crash on newer Android versions. When exact-alarm access is unavailable, the scheduler uses an approximate alarm.
- Routes app shortcuts, notification taps, and external sync intents through the same file-access check.
- Asks for notification permission after unlocking so sync progress can appear on Android 13 and newer.

This update uses the established package and signing certificate, so it installs over earlier SMBsync+ releases without clearing saved tasks or credentials. Android may ask you to enable **Allow access to manage all files** after updating.

SMBsync+ is based on [SMBSync2 by Sentaroh](https://github.com/Sentaroh/SMBSync2). Source and license notices remain in this repository.
